mapper.select: /* SchoolRecordInfoMapper.findByStdtIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc */ SELECT FROM school_record_info WHERE stdt_id = #{stdtId} AND tc_id = #{tcId} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: /* SchoolRecordInfoMapper.deactivateSchoolRecordById */ UPDATE school_record_info SET use_yn = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: /* SchoolRecordInfoMapper.upsertSchoolRecordDraft */ INSERT INTO school_record_info (stdt_id, cla_id, tc_id, category, content, strengths, improvements, status, observation_input, generated_text, source, use_yn, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{stdtId}, #{claId}, #{tcId}, #{category}, #{content}, #{strengths}, #{improvements}, #{status}, #{observationInput}, #{generatedText}, #{source}, 'Y', #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE previous_content = content, cla_id = VALUES(cla_id), content = VALUES(content), strengths = VALUES(strengths), improvements = VALUES(improvements), status = VALUES(status), observation_input = VALUES(observation_input), generated_text = VALUES(generated_text), source = VALUES(source), use_yn = 'Y', updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: /* SchoolRecordInfoMapper.selectDraftListByClass */ SELECT stdt_id AS studentId , status AS status , strengths AS strengths , improvements AS improvements , DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS savedAt FROM school_record_info WHERE cla_id = #{claId} AND tc_id = #{tcId} AND category = 'comprehensive' AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY updated_at DESC
